_comment: The sizes an engine kit comes in (see docs/modding.md, "engine_kits.json"): an engine build's parts in one crate, as
far as the size takes them, put together on the engine stand in one go. A size names the work order kinds
(work_order.json's) of the parts it holds, "includes" another size's, or holds "all" the build lists. Smallest first:
a used kit is never short of the first size's parts. Its words are the text pool's kits.size.<id>. A mod's size of
the same id takes the place of this one, whole; "disabled": true takes it out.
